# Educaplay

> Educaplay is a free educational games generator that transforms content into engaging, interactive learning activities powered by AI.

Educaplay provides educators and content creators with tools to build diverse game-based learning activities. The platform features AI-powered content creation through its Ray assistant, supports multiple learning management systems (Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams, Moodle, Canvas), and offers multilingual support including Arabic and Hebrew.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered game creation
- Educational games
- Interactive learning
- Game customization
- LMS integration
- Ray AI assistant
- Quiz builder
- Gamification
- Multilingual support
- Free game maker
- Google Classroom
- Microsoft Teams

- Canvas

- [Quiz maker - Educaplay](https://www.educaplay.com/types-of-activities/quizzes.html): Quiz maker with AI assistant Ray supporting multiple question types
- [Word Search maker - Educaplay](https://www.educaplay.com/types-of-activities/word-search-puzzles.html): Word Search Puzzle maker with AI assistant Ray for instant creation
- [Crossword maker - Educaplay](https://www.educaplay.com/types-of-activities/crossword-puzzles.html): Crossword Puzzle creator with AI-powered editor and multilingual support
- [Video Quiz maker - Educaplay](https://www.educaplay.com/types-of-activities/video-quizzes.html): Video Quiz creator integrating questions into YouTube videos with LMS support
- [Fill in the blank generator - Educaplay](https://www.educaplay.com/types-of-activities/fill-in-the-blanks-games.html): Fill in the blank game generator with AI-powered content creation
